answer: Anchor each identity to a household smart meter. First, the utility signs a one-time binding between the agent and one meter, so one meter backs only one identity. Second, at dawn each epoch the meter signs a fresh consumption reading, proving a real home stands behind the account. Third, two identities on one meter flag both and freeze rewards until an audit clears them. Faking 1,000 identities means renting 1,000 real homes at 400 dollars per meter, 400,000 dollars before a single task. Like a reef, the network only grows where real life anchors it, on shale and concrete, not sand.
